issues.problem: kara-because contrast claimed ので cannot end a sentence; sentence-final ので in inverted or elliptical sentences (先に帰ります。用事があるので。) is common. The real restriction is that ので cannot take だ/です.
issues.action: Reworded to 'ので cannot take です: say からです, not のでです.'

issues.problem: te-kara mistake 音楽を聞いてから勉強します is a natural, grammatical sentence with a different meaning, so it does not show a real error.
issues.action: Replaced with a real てから error: 家に帰ってから、手紙が来ていた (a discovery needs たら) -> 家に帰ったら、手紙が来ていた.

issues.problem: te-kara mistake ご飯を食べたから、出かけました can be read as a grammatical reason clause, so it is not clearly wrong.
issues.action: Replaced with 大阪に引っ越したから、五年になります -> 引っ越してから (the 'since' sense needs てから).

issues.problem: explain said ので cannot end a sentence and that the answer to どうして is から only; ので alone is an acceptable soft answer.
issues.action: Rewrote the sentence: ので cannot take だ/です (からです, never のでです); a bare answer is normally から, and ので alone sounds like a soft excuse.

issues.problem: contrast から repeated the false 'only から can end a sentence' claim.
issues.action: Changed to 'Only から can take です (からです)'.

issues.problem: tip 'Does the sentence end right there? Use から' would teach the learner to reject valid sentence-final ので.
issues.action: Changed to 'です right after it? Use から instead.'

issues.problem: noni-although example 日曜日なのに、会社に行きます can read as a future intention, which the guide's own rule says のに cannot take.
issues.action: Replaced with a plain past fact: 日曜日なのに、父は会社に行きました。 / My father went to work even though it was Sunday.

issues.problem: noni-purpose contrast ために listed fewer predicates than explain (left out 役に立つ), making 'only' inconsistent.
issues.action: Reworded to 'usefulness or cost predicates: 使う, 役に立つ, 便利, 必要, いい, かかる'.
